name: Sunken Temple
description: The moss-covered roof of an ancient stone structure juts out from the dark waters of the swamp. It appears to be sinking slowly into the mire.

discovery.message: Through the thick swamp mist, you spot the vine-draped ruins of a large stone building.

approach.text: You must wade through waist-deep, foul-smelling mud to reach the entrance.
approach.success_text: You push through the muck and reach the stone steps of the temple.
approach.failure_text: The mud is thick and exhausting. You eventually reach the temple, but you're worn out.

approach-fail.text: Your muscles ache from the struggle. (Gained 2 Fatigue)

temple-entry.text: The heavy stone doors are ajar. Inside, a main hallway leads deep into the structure, but you notice a narrow, dry crack in the wall to the right.

choices.label: Follow the moonlit current toward the Mirror Pool.
[Perception 16] Examine the crack in the wall.

temple-guardian.text: A pale, flickering light floats in the darkness of the hall. As you approach, it lunges!

secret-passage-find.text: The crack leads to a narrow maintenance tunnel that bypasses the main hall. It seems much safer.

choices.label: Go back and take the main hall anyway.

temple-boss.text: In the main chamber, a massive spider has spun its web across the altar. It drops from the ceiling to defend its lair!

temple-altar.text: Behind the spider's web, the ancient altar holds a few remaining treasures.

altar-depths.text: Behind the altar, a stair descends into black water that does not ripple. Cold air breathes up out of it.

choices.label: Go down into the inner sanctum.

sanctum-shadows.text: The stair ends in a drowned chapel lit by nothing. Two shadows peel away from the walls, reaching for your strength.

sanctum-keeper.text: A gaunt figure in rotted black robes rises from prayer at the far end. 'You will not take it,' she says. 'It sees. It has always seen.'

the-eye.text: On a plinth at the heart of the chapel, a black gem the size of your fist pulses slowly, like a heart. When you lift it, you hear whispering.

temple-leave.text: You climb back up into the grey swamp light, gasping for air that does not smell of the dead.

crushing-depths.text: The current runs down a flooded corridor. The air presses on you like deep water, and the dark seems to lean closer the further you go.
crushing-depths.success_text: You keep your breathing slow and your eyes on the faint silver light ahead, and the weight lifts.
crushing-depths.failure_text: Panic closes your throat. You stumble back toward the entrance.

false-lights.text: Three lights drift out of the dark ahead, warm and beckoning. As you step toward them, they flare and dive at you.

mirror-pool.text: The corridor opens on a round chamber with a hole in its roof. Moonlight falls straight down into a pool so still it looks like a second sky.

the-reflection.text: You kneel at the edge and wait for the water to settle, watching for the moment the moon in the pool is perfect.
the-reflection.success_text: There. You cup your hands and lift the moon out of the water. It hardens in your palms into a pale, glowing shard.
the-reflection.failure_text: A ripple, and the moment's gone. You'll have to wait again.

moon-shard.text: The Moon Essence Shard: moonlight set solid, glowing even here in the dark.

pool-guardians.text: The pool's surface splits. Black tentacles rise out of it, groping for the light in your hands.

more-tentacles.text: Two more burst up behind you.

the-dryad.text: A woman of grey bark and black sap steps out of the wall where a dead root has grown through. She was a dryad once. 'Give it back,' she whispers. 'It isn't yours. Nothing is yours.'

pool-quiet.text: The pool goes still again. The shard in your pack glows a little brighter, as if relieved.
